# Van Phu Dalat Motorbike Rental (Thuê xe máy Đà Lạt Văn Phú)

> Local motorbike and scooter rental in Da Lat (Đà Lạt), Vietnam. Honda Vision 110cc, Honda Air Blade 125cc and electric scooters, all 150,000 VND per day. No cash deposit, free hotel delivery in central Da Lat for rentals of 2+ days.

## Key facts
- Address: 1/15/5 Thông Thiên Học, Đà Lạt, Vietnam (https://maps.app.goo.gl/ULvgaZFh4Q1kjTCe6)
- Price: 150,000 VND/day for every bike, fixed, no hidden fees
- Opening hours: every day 4:30 AM – 9:00 PM
- Rental day: from pickup until 9:00 PM the same day
- Deposit: no cash deposit; the guest leaves a passport or ID card; rental fee paid upfront
- Included: free helmet and phone holder with every bike; gas scooters come with 1 liter of fuel
- Delivery: free to hotels in central Da Lat for rentals of 2 days or more
- Before renting: test ride and a video of the bike's condition, filmed together
- Phone: +84 944 081 101
- Booking: WhatsApp +84 944 081 101 or +84 834 622 149, Zalo 0944 081 101, Telegram @vanphudalat, WeChat vanphudalat
- YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@DalatMotorbikeRentalVanPhu
- Languages on the website: EN, RU, 中文, 한국어, 日本語, ไทย, ID, MY, VI, DE, FR, ES, עב, IT, NL, ខ្មែរ, ລາວ, မြန်မာ

## Quick answers
- **How much does motorbike rental in Da Lat cost?** Any bike in our rental — Honda Vision, Honda Air Blade 125cc or an electric scooter — costs 150,000 VND per day. Fixed price, no hidden fees.
- **Do I need to leave a cash deposit?** No. There's no cash deposit: you leave your passport or ID card during the rental. The rental fee is paid in full upfront.
- **How is one rental day counted?** From pickup until 9:00 PM the same day. Returning by 9:00 PM the next day counts as 2 days, and so on.
- **Do you deliver to hotels?** Yes. For rentals of 2 days or more we deliver the bike free of charge to hotels in central Da Lat.
- **What's included with the bike?** A free helmet and a phone holder come with every bike, and gas scooters are handed over with 1 liter of fuel.
- **Which bike should I choose?** For town and short trips, the Honda Vision and electric scooters are light and quiet. For hills and trips out of town, such as the Cau Dat tea hills, take the Honda Air Blade 125cc — it has more power on climbs.
- **Can I book in advance?** Yes. Send your dates and hotel name on WhatsApp, Zalo or WeChat and we'll confirm and prepare the bike.
- **Where is the shop?** Van Phu is at 1/15/5 Thông Thiên Học, Da Lat. It's marked on Google Maps — https://maps.app.goo.gl/ULvgaZFh4Q1kjTCe6.
